name: Hygraph MCP
description: Connect Claude to Hygraph to manage content and evolve your content model using natural language. Explore projects, discover schemas, search and retrieve entries, create and update content, publish entries, and run safe GraphQL operations. You can also inspect project configuration, apply schema migrations, and - where enabled - run Hygraph agents and monitor their progress. Ideal for content teams and developers who want to work with Hygraph without leaving Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hygraph MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hygraph MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hygraph.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hygraph MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hygraph MCP lists 19 MCP tools, including check_progress, create_entry, discover_entities, execute_graphql, get_ai_guidelines, get_entities_by_id, get_entity_schema, get_management_operation_schema, get_project_info, list_agents, list_entities, and list_entity_types.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hygraph MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hygraph MCP in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Hygraph MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hygraph MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hygraph MCP is developed by Hygraph. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
